sub_sector.value: specialty commercial property and casualty insurance; title insurance; surety and warranty

financial_business_type.detail: Specialty insurer with operating companies in general insurance, title, surety, warranty, workers' compensation, plus claims services.

revenue_driver.detail: Underwriting premiums on specialty coverages; investment income on reserves; some fees from claims and risk services.

customer_type.detail: Businesses across construction, healthcare, transportation, real estate; public entities and nonprofits; title and warranty for consumers.

balance_sheet_dependence.detail: Underwrites risk and carries claims obligations, relying on financial strength and ratings to meet obligations.

notes: Title insurance is a major second segment; the evidence lists it only as one operating company.
